name: C1808

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory; Cheng Shin also makes bicycle tires at a mainland plant.

positioning: CST folding 120 TPI training clincher with a dual compound and puncture layer.
weight_basis: The listing gives one 225 g weight without a size, so no size weight is recorded.

community.summary: Owner weighed a 28C at 260 g and rated it the most puncture- and wear-resistant of four budget clinchers.

availability.note: Sold by Tmall and Taobao shops; no official CST store listing was read for this model.
